Archive bytes and SHA256 cannot be verified because the zip is absent from both incoming and source.

The native/notify-launch hash is unverifiable without the binary. GCC -O2 produces environment-specific hashes, and recompilation would violate the no-tests rule.

A brief review of agent_observer and MCP is next.
